decisions.reason: The paperback-format impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The back-matter requirement was already scoped to the paperback publication package, and confirming the format does not change its content or scope.
The copyediting requirement was already established for the paperback manuscript, and the format confirmation does not alter its editing rules or scope.
Confirming paperback publication does not necessarily change the existing chapter-illustration coverage, placement, review criteria, or interior scope.
The paperback confirmation does not change the publisher line or the copyright-page content and layout requirement.
Publication format does not alter the established Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization requirements.
Confirming paperback publication does not resolve the separate uncertainty about whether the interior title page should include an image.
The paperback confirmation does not change the prohibition on the literal newline artifact in the book title.
